definitions.explanation: The practice of sampling and evaluating different types of sake, either professionally or as a leisure activity.

examples.japanese: {酒蔵|さかぐら}で{利|き}き{酒|ざけ}を{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: I enjoyed sake tasting at the brewery.

examples.japanese: {利|き}き{酒|ざけ}セットを{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: I ordered a sake tasting set.

examples.japanese: {利|き}き{酒|ざけ}で{好|す}きな{銘柄|めいがら}を{見|み}つけた。
examples.english: I found my favorite brand through sake tasting.

notes:
FORMS:
{利|き}き (tasting/discerning) + {酒|さけ}→ざけ (sake)

Note: {酒|さけ} becomes {酒|ざけ} (rendaku) in this compound.

PROFESSIONAL CONTEXT:
- {利|き}き{酒師|ざけし} (certified sake sommelier)
- {全国|ぜんこく}{新酒|しんしゅ}{鑑評会|かんぴょうかい} (National New Sake Competition)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {利|き}き{酒|ざけ}をする (to do sake tasting)
- {利|き}き{酒|ざけ}セット (sake tasting set)
- {利|き}き{酒|ざけ}イベント (sake tasting event)

RELATED TASTINGS:
- {利|き}きワイン (wine tasting)
- {利|き}きビール (beer tasting)
